'''Jekhop''', also known as '''the Bowed Lord''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] who was part of the [[Infernal Council]], a group of Sith enslaved by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Soa]] and imprisoned with him in the [[Eternity Vault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Eternity Vault" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jekhop, the Bowed Lord appears as one of the enemies in the Infernal Council boss encounter in the "Eternity Vault" Operation in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Jekhop only appears in the sixteen-man difficulty modes of the operation.<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
